summary: Frontend test of the new 'Ufficio / sezione dedicata (Indice PA)' field in PartyDialog. All checks passed: (1) in the new-cliente dialog the field (party-ufficio-pa-input) sits right after Ragione sociale; (2) the supplier dialog does not show it; (3) PA switch -> IPA search 'comune di pisa' -> picking ipa-result-UF5YHL fills denominazione 'Comune di Pisa', ufficio_pa 'Uff_eFatturaPA', CF/PIVA 00341620508, codice destinatario UF5YHL, 'Via Degli Uffizi 1', 56120, Pisa, PI, PEC comune.pisa@postacert.toscana.it, nazione IT, and shows a success toast; (4) after renaming to TEST_Comune di Pisa and saving, the reopened cliente still has ufficio_pa=Uff_eFatturaPA; (5) delete from the UI removed it (0 rows in the DB).
critical_code_review_comments: The ufficio_pa field is shown for every cliente, PA or not. Consider showing it only when pubblica_amministrazione is on, or adding a hint that it is optional.
PaSearch onPick always overwrites codice_destinatario with r.codice_uo; every other field falls back to the existing value. This is fine for an IPA pick.
test_credentials: Admin fabrizio.gemignani@gmail.com logs in fine, but this account has no company (company_ids []), so after login it lands on 'Crea la prima azienda' and cannot reach Anagrafiche. To leave real data untouched, the test used a temporary TEST_T107 company and admin session.
seed_data_creation: seed_ui_t107_ufficio_pa.py setup created the TEST_T107 PA Srl company, user test-user-t107-admin and session test_session_t107_admin. 'clean' removed them all, and the TEST_Comune di Pisa party was deleted through the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real admin has no companies in the DB. For UI tests run: cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && . ../frontend/.env && set +a && python tests/seed_ui_t107_ufficio_pa.py setup (prints CID). Then add cookie session_token=test_session_t107_admin and localStorage fe_company_id=CID, and go to /anagrafiche. Run 'clean' at the end. The IndicePA search is live; it took under 30s.
